text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

COAL - Sept 30 - Queensland, Abbot Point, seven vessels due by 23/10. No delays. Dalrymple Bay two vessels loading, 2 waiting, 14 due by 15/10. 1 day's delay. Hay Point - two vessels loading, 6 waiting, 17 due by 20/10. 3-4 days delay. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna 1 vessel loading. 23 due by 30/10. 1 day's delay. Barney Point no nominations until 25/10 due to maintenance shutdown. Brisbane - two vessels due by 3/11. No delays.

New South Wales - Newcastle dyke loaders 2 vessels loading. 4 waiting. 13 due by 14/10. 3-5 days delay. Kooragang 2 loading, 4 waiting, 14 due by 14/10. 3-5 days delay. Port Kembla one vessel loading, 18 due by 5/11. 1 day's delay.

IRON ORE, Western Australia - Dampier - Parker Point 1 loading, 1 anchored. E.I. Is 1 loading, 2 anchored. 14 due by 9/10. Port Walcott - one vessel loading, 5 due by 4/10. Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) berth A 2 vessels due by 4/10. Berth B 1 loading. 4 due by 9/10. 8 others due with no ETA. Goldsworthy 1 loading, 2 due by 4/10. 1 other due, no ETA.

GRAIN, Queensland - Mackay - one wheat vessel due 15/10, 1 maize 10/11. Gladstone - four vessels due (wheat, sorghum, peas). Brisbane - one wheat vessel due 14/10. NSW - Newcastle - four wheat vessels due by 10/10. Silo not working due to public holiday 7/10. Sydney - no further grain loading expected. Port Kembla - two wheat vessels due. Victoria - Geelong - one loading wheat. 9 due by 20/10 (wheat, barley, oats, peas). Portland - four vessels due by 14/10 (wheat, barley).

South Australia - Port Pirie - one vessel loading wheat. 2 due by 11/10 (barley, wheat). Port Adelaide - one vessel loading barley. 4 due by 15/10 (malt, wheat, barley). Thevenard, Port Lincoln, Wallaroo, Ardrossan, Port Giles - no vessels due.

Western Australia - Geraldton - one vessel loading lupins. 2 wheat vessels due by 6/10. Kwinana - two loading wheat. 1 wheat vessel in port. 5 due by 17/10 (barley, wheat, lupins). Loading terminal has come to agreement with unions and evening shifts as well as day now operating Monday to Friday. Albany - four wheat vessels due by 16/10. Esperance - one barley vessel due 7/10.
